it was absolutely great even WITH our. slight. timezone disadvantage
re: crafting, just noting that I'm making a spreadsheet to try and make it easier for everyone next year, I'm assigning essences to `everything` for DMs to approve so that people don't have to wonder for ages if it's the right type
so if that's a thought you had, don't worry, it's in progress already

Hello I have a lot to say, cuz its me and I'm extra. I will say, that I know some of the stuff I will mention is already being addressed but its still worth mentioning. As always this game is a lot of fun and I respect the amount of work put into it. The people, DMs, mods, and players are what keep this game interesting and enjoyable. The amount of times I tell my irl friends about this game is ridiculous, I always have a story to tell whenever I play here with y'all. That being said, I want to be transparent about some issues, of course there can never be a perfect game but I wanted to provide some feedback. So here we go

Things I loved: 
• The arcaniabot was amazing: props to Roy 
• The long rest thing actually made me take brakes from playing and also was motivation to wake up the same time as my player (I know in season 3 I would play literally all night) 
• I loved being able to learn the gun prof. 
• The crafting was cool, I still struggled with it but that's nothing new, 3 years in a row and crafting has always been kinda hard for me to grasp. I've only ever understood the season 2 version
• The chance to create a new form of government and debate it. It drove me crazy but I loved it. Being able to shape world we are apart of in multiple ways is really cool
• Running with character choices, running npcs, quests we choose to work with
• Shoutout to Radar for all the fun little chaos moments, giving us laughs and things we love to hate (Vanderbuilt)


The break and inactiveivity:
• The DMs didn't end the break at the expected time so it was 2 weeks long
• The amount of active players cut down 
• Even if there were no encounters or interactions from DMs we still could have done things like planned player/mod ran events, I wanted to have a shooting competition for example but it felt like I couldn't organize it
• We could have done crafting, learning a skill or something that felt like we were progressing throughout the break

Running the game:
• Encounter balance was rough, maybe have a mod or someone dedicated to balancing because some things were too much (hence so many deaths) 
• Would have liked to see more communication between DMs. 
• Encounter conditions should not be based on rounds before pcs can move on that will only make combat take hours. Waiting a specific # of pc turns is more predictable no matter how many people are in init (Hampstead bomb event) 

Other things:
• Maybe have a chat dedicated to planning that is separate from ooc so information doesn't get lost
• I like risk with death, this season if felt like death was more of a means for transformation rather than risk. I understand it was created this way as a response to the events of season 3, but the motivation and weight that came from those who went through the hatch was also some of my favorite moments. Maybe find balance between the two?
we did it a grand total of once this season but naming enemy creatures was actually super helpful in combat and we should do it more lol
